Name: Valley Girls Different skin tones for the farmer
Author: Loki101idk
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I already had the assets from a different [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40559]mod[/url] and I had actually been planning on making this for a while now but just hadn't gotten around to it till now. so What's this mod do? well currently it changes the skin tone used in Valley girl to one other however the plan is to add a few more. the next two that are planed will be one that is very pale (Looks like a vampire) and a darker tone that will be between the original Valley girls and the one currently made.(Prolly similar to Maru in tone) feel free to suggest any other skin tones that are in the vanilla Game. (I won't do all of them as I don't have the time however if you suggest it I'll prolly take a look.)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Download Valley girls and install into mods folder then move the [CP] VALLEY GIRLS folder from this mod to the mods folder (MAKE SURE TO OVERWRITE THE FILE)

[size=4][b]Requirements [/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Valley Girls[/color][/size]

[b]Compatibility [/b]
Not Compatible with any of the NTR mods as many of the jsons had to be changed so that the skin tone change only changed the farmer.
Not Compatible with any Mods that Valley girls is not compatible with. 
Probably not combatable with any translated mods unless they are made specifically for this mod.

Note to translators
This mod only changes a few of the $# so it would be very easy to translate. for the farmer events $37=$59 $39=$61 $41=$63 $43=$65 $45=$67.
